prompt.en: Into how many distinct regions does Discover Canada divide the country?
prompt.fr: En combien de régions distinctes Découvrir le Canada divise-t-il le pays?

explanation.en: Discover Canada names five: the Atlantic Provinces, Central Canada, the Prairie Provinces, the West Coast and the Northern Territories.
explanation.fr: Découvrir le Canada en nomme cinq : les provinces de l'Atlantique, le Centre du Canada, les provinces des Prairies, la côte Ouest et les territoires du Nord.

source.quote: Canada includes many different geographical areas and five distinct regions.

verification.evidence: Canada includes many different geographical areas and five distinct regions. • The Atlantic Provinces • Central Canada • The Prairie Provinces • The West Coast • The Northern Territories
